a: Continuously verify identity and device posture, not just once at login.
Device posture checks OS version, disk encryption, and compliance.
JIT access grants temporary elevated permissions.
PAM controls and audits privileged credentials.
Scan full git history when secrets may have been committed.
Rotate credentials immediately after any suspected leak.
Grant only required actions on required resources.
Encrypt sensitive data at rest with managed keys when possible.
Use TLS for data in transit on public networks.
